description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-ORDER: For three groups whose rows are interleaved in storage (FOI: ids 1-9 in insertion order; FOV: the same rows with ids reversed and an index on g), what exact bits do Sum, Avg, Var, VarP, StDev and StDevP give per GROUP BY group without ORDER BY, with ORDER BY g and g DESC, through a derived table ordered by id and by id DESC, and under WHERE g >= 1; and in which order do the group rows come out? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
retentionNote: Designed r-par-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
